calculation_contract.cosmology: Flat LCDM with H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc and Omega_m = 0.3
calculation_contract.renderer: Normalised, explanatory reconstruction; not a pixel fit to the credited observation
calculation_contract.mass_proxy: Two singular-isothermal-sphere Einstein radii controlled by one velocity-dispersion parameter

systems.name: Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-56)
systems.finding: The lensing-derived total-mass peaks approximately follow the collisionless galaxies rather than the X-ray-bright gas.
systems.caution: The map shown here is a schematic layer model. Published mass maps require shape calibration, redshift estimates, inversion choices and uncertainty propagation.

systems.name: MACS J0025.4-1222
systems.finding: A second merging system shows total-mass peaks separated from the centrally concentrated X-ray gas.
systems.caution: The merger geometry and projection are system-specific; similarity to the Bullet Cluster is evidence for replication, not identical dynamics.

systems.name: Abell 520
systems.finding: Published reconstructions have debated whether a central mass concentration is present, making this a useful systematic-stress case.
systems.caution: Treat the central peak as disputed and reconstruction-dependent; do not generalise it as a settled dark-matter morphology.
